definitions.explanation: A traditional Japanese seasoning made from fermented soybeans. Used in soups, sauces, and marinades.

examples.japanese: {朝|あさ}ごはんに{味噌汁|みそしる}を{飲|の}みます。
examples.english: I have miso soup for breakfast.

examples.japanese: この{味噌|みそ}は{甘|あま}いです。
{味噌|みそ}は{体|からだ}にいいです。
examples.english: Miso is good for your health.

examples.japanese: {母|はは}は{毎朝|まいあさ}{味噌汁|みそしる}を{作|つく}ってくれます。
examples.english: My mother makes miso soup every morning.

examples.japanese: {味噌|みそ}には{白|しろ}と{赤|あか}があって、{地域|ちいき}によって{好|この}みが{違|ちが}います。
examples.english: There is white and red miso, and preferences differ by region.

notes: {味噌|みそ} is a staple of Japanese cuisine. There are many varieties including {白味噌|しろみそ} (white/sweet), {赤味噌|あかみそ} (red), and {合|あ}わせ{味噌|みそ} (mixed). {味噌汁|みそしる} (miso soup) is a daily essential in many Japanese households.
